title: MySyndrome - Rare Disease Patient Registry for Treatability, Natural History, Phenotype and Psychosozial Aspects of Rare Genetic Developmental Diseases
summary: With advances in genetic diagnostics, the cause of a developmental disorder can now be revealed for many patients, often times it is a rare genetic disease. Many of these are even diseases that have only been described in the last 5 years. Mostly, very few people are known to be affected. We developed this registry to learn more about these rare diseases. Above all, we are interested in what treatments are able to help our patients, as well as which symptoms they show, which additional diseases occur more frequently and how those affected and their families are doing in everyday life.
